description: List customer reviews for a tour (rating outline plus individual review items).

currency.description: Currency for prices, ISO 4217 (e.g. USD, EUR). Defaults to GYG_CURRENCY when set.

language.description: Content language (e.g. en, de). Defaults to GYG_LANGUAGE when set.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-500).

offset.description: Number of reviews to skip (0-based; the API caps review offsets at 300).

name: gyg_get_tour_reviews
